variants.title: Night hotel presentation
variants.navigation: Engraved name and one booking action over the photograph; chapter links to the room page and drawer triggers.

ordered_sections.pattern: Full-screen night photograph whose lamps come on once, with name and one action
Large photograph with short text per chapter
Side drawer with month grid, guests, room and extras

variants.mobile_reflow: Photograph and heading fill the first phone screen; facts, chapters and room cards stack; the drawer becomes full width.
distinguishing_features: Night photograph that lights up once
Chapters of single large images and short text

variants.title: Room gallery and comparison
variants.navigation: Name, hotel and rooms links, one booking action, an edge tab and per-room choose buttons.

ordered_sections.pattern: Shorter photograph band with the chosen dates
Alternating wide image and detail column per room

variants.mobile_reflow: Band, then each room as image above details; the table scrolls inside its own region; the edge tab becomes a bottom pill.
distinguishing_features: Room gallery instead of a narrative
Dates summary that mirrors the drawer
